title: Microsoft outage hits businesses worldwide; India feels impact
summary: Disruption to Microsoft’s cloud-based email service affects business operations and airline customer support in India; public services in several countries also report problems
llm_summary: A global outage of Microsoft’s cloud‑based email service has crippled business communications, prompting airline customer‑support centers in India to halt operations and causing hiccups in public‑service platforms across several countries. The disruption underscores how reliant modern enterprises are on Microsoft 365 for daily workflows and highlights the ripple effects when a single cloud provider experiences downtime.
